Sri.V. Vijaya Saradhi vs The State Of Telangana on 6 March,
2025
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Writ Petition No.22795 of 2016
Order:

entities.text: Sri.V. Vijaya Saradhi vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"... to issue an appropriate Writ, order or direction more particularly in the nature of writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of the 2nd Respondent in furnishing LAOP (Land Acquisition Original Petition) number in respect of proceedings No.LA/UnitIV/43- 2/2005 dated-22-01-2009 before Hon'ble Principal District judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B. Nagar to the petitioner despite representation dated 24.03.2016 to get adequate compensation in favour of the petitioner along with other claimants as arbitrary, illegal, capricious and violative of Article 300-A and 350 of Constitution of India and also violative of provisions of Land Acquisition Act and direct the 2nd Respondent to furnish LAOP (Land Acquisition Original Petition)
number in respect of proceedings No.LA/UnitIV/43-2/2005 dated-22-01-2009 before Hon'ble Principal District Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B. Nagar forthwith pending disposal of the above writ petition ..."

entities.text: Principal District Judge, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Rama Murty P.V.S.A., learned counsel for the petitioner through video conference,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent No.1 and the learned Standing Counsel for Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority (HMDA)
appearing on behalf of respondent No.2.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that respondent No.2 acquired the property of the petitioner i.e., house in plot No.171/B and 171/C admeasuring 125 square yards each in Sy.Nos.560 and 561 situated at Ghatkesar Village and Mandal of Ranga Reddy District (presently Medchal Malkajgiri District) by initiating land acquisition proceedings No.LA/UnitIV/43-2/2005 and passed the Award on 22.01.2009 exercising the powers conferred under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').

By virtue of rival disputes, the respondent authorities referred the matter under Sections 30 and 31 of the Act to the competent Civil Court namely Principal District Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar through proceedings dated 22.01.2009.

entities.text: Principal District Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, the respondent authorities have not furnished the LAOP Number.
The action of respondent No.2 in not furnishing LAOP number in respect of the proceedings No.LA/Unit-IV/43-2/2005 dated 22.01.2009 is contrary to law.
Hence the petitioner approached this Court and filed the present writ petition.

4. Learned Standing Counsel as well as learned Assistant Government Pleader submitted that if the Sri.V. Vijaya Saradhi vs The State Of Telangana on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135162612/
1 proceedings under Sections 30 and 31 of the Act are pending before the competent Civil Court,
respondent No.2 will furnish the LAOP number to the petitioner by way of registered post with acknowledgment due.
5. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any view on merits of the case, this Court deemed it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition directing respondent No.2 to furnish LAOP number in respect of the proceedings No.LA/Unit-IV/43-2/2005 dated 22.01.2009 to the petitioner through registered post with acknowledgment due, within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6.

sentences.text: With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
